def find_in_ascii(frame_ascii, char):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    positions = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        for j, c in enumerate(line):
            if c == char:
                positions.append((i, j))
    return positions

# Check player position
y_curr = sorted(find_in_ascii(current_frame.ascii, 'Y'))
gameplay_y = [p for p in y_curr if 5 < p[0] < 60]
print(f"Player position: {gameplay_y}")

# Check green square position
g_curr = sorted(find_in_ascii(current_frame.ascii, 'N'))
print(f"Green square position: {g_curr}")

# Check red center positions
r_curr = sorted(find_in_ascii(current_frame.ascii, 'R'))
print(f"Red center positions: {r_curr}")

# Check what changed
if last_transition:
    before_lines = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    after_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    changes = []
    for i, (b, a) in enumerate(zip(before_lines, after_lines)):
        for j, (bc, ac) in enumerate(zip(b, a)):
            if bc != ac:
                changes.append((i, j, bc, ac))
    gameplay_changes = [c for c in changes if c[0] > 5]
    print(f"Gameplay changes: {gameplay_changes}")

# Layout
curr_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("Layout (rows 20-35, cols 0-20):")
for i in range(20, 36):
    row = curr_lines[i]
    simplified = ''.join(['.' if c == 'c' else c for c in row[0:21]])
    print(f"Row {i}: '{simplified}'")

</function>
</tool_call>
